note:
THE THIRD IMAGE of the /pages/brightening-glow set — templates/page.brightening-glow.json, section `content`, block `together` ('The Multi-Pathway Brightening System'). It currently wears a serum dropper photograph. Companion to block-brightening-glow-pair, which fills `causes` and `approach` on the same page; every constraint in that file applies here and is not repeated in full.

CARRIED OVER WITHOUT CHANGE: square-on front elevation, cut face parallel to the picture plane, no perspective, top surface a sliver at most; the same layer stack in the same order; the camera high in the block so the surface and the granular band dominate; generic skin colour, no brand colour, no Champagne; soft translucent warm brown for pigment and nothing metallic; smooth glossy CGI, high-key, soft diffuse light, no lettering or callout furniture; square 2048x2048.

THE JOB OF THIS FRAME IS SIMULTANEITY, AND THAT IS WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM ITS TWO SIBLINGS. `causes` is a picture of one problem, `approach` is a picture of one mechanism — the antioxidant meeting the oxidative stress. This block says something the other two do not: that THREE THINGS ARE HAPPENING AT ONCE, at three different depths, and that is the argument the copy makes ('Most brightening products target only one thing. Our approach combines three'). If this frame reads as another single-mechanism picture with more spheres in it, it has failed.

SO THE THREE PATHWAYS ARE SEPARATED BY DEPTH, NOT BY POSITION. A left-centre-right arrangement would be a triptych, which is the split-frame this family has negated since the copper-peptide r3 — and it would also imply the three act on three different bits of skin, when the copy's whole point is that they act on the same skin together. Stacking them by depth is both truer and safer:

  TOP, AT THE SURFACE ITSELF   Hydration & Glow. The quilted pads are swollen, rounder and
                               glassier than in any other frame in this set, with tiny clear
                               droplets held inside them in three distinct sizes — the 'triple'
                               hyaluronic complex, made visible as a count rather than a caption.
                               A clean bright specular sheen runs along the top of the block: this
                               is the literal claim, 'improving light reflection for immediate
                               luminosity', and it is the one thing in the frame a shopper reads
                               as glow. It is also the strongest single differentiator from the
                               approach frame, which has no such sheen.

  IN THE AIR AND JUST BELOW    Antioxidant Defence. Dark grey angular motes fall toward the skin
                               and break up, thin and vanish before they land. One further beat
                               is included because the copy names it: 'glutathione helps recycle
                               vitamins C and E'. So one faceted crystal that has gone dull and
                               clouded sits beside a three-bead chain, and where the two meet the
                               crystal is clearing back to bright and glassy. That is a
                               regeneration loop drawn as an event, with no arrow and no label.

  DEEP, IN THE GRANULAR BAND   Even-Looking Tone. Shafts from the longer bead chains reach down
                               into the band where the pigment sits, and the granules there are
                               settled and evenly distributed rather than clustered.

NOTHING IS BLEACHED, HERE OR ANYWHERE ON THIS PAGE. No pigment is destroyed, lifted, erased or faded out; the deep band simply reads even. The copy is hedged — 'support a brighter, more even-looking complexion' — and the page's own FAQ answers 'Is glutathione safe for all skin tones?', so lightening imagery would be both an overclaim and off-brand. Negated by name.

BEAD COUNTS ARE ACCURATE, WHICH IS THE QUIET PLEASURE OF THIS SET. Glutathione is a tripeptide, so THREE beads. The copy also names Nonapeptide-1 and Tetrapeptide-1, so NINE beads and FOUR. Vitamin C is a colourless faceted crystal because ascorbic acid is crystalline. A viewer will never count them, but the forms differ visibly and none of it is invented.

GHK-Cu IS NAMED IN THE COPY AND IS DELIBERATELY NOT GIVEN ITS OWN DEVICE. Everywhere else on this store GHK-Cu is copper beads, and copper is /pages/copper-peptide-research's colour. Importing it here would put another page's ingredient identity into this one and break the generic-skin rule these three frames were built on. The copy's structure is THREE PATHWAYS, not five molecules; the frame depicts the pathways.

TWO SLOTS, ONE PICTURE, TWO DISTANCES: A the whole block with all three depths legible, B closer with the surface sheen and the plumped pads dominant and the deep action still visible along the bottom. Not two different pictures — the concept is settled by the copy.

CLASS B, no references, FLUX.2 in the run. JUDGE AT 100% AND AT RENDER SIZE (660px), with the four checks from this set: texture coherence, hollow tube ends, pigment must not read as dirt or a scab, and now a fifth — THE SHEEN MUST NOT BLOW OUT. A specular band that clips to flat white loses the quilting underneath and turns the top of the block into a bare stripe; it has to read as light ON a surface, with the pads still modelled through it.

slots.title: system A · the whole block, three pathways legible at three depths at once
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and fills the lower two thirds of the height, leaving clear hazy air above it. The camera sits high in the block: the surface and the layers just beneath it fill most of it, and only the top of the deeper zone shows along the bottom edge.

THE LAYERS, FROM TOP TO BOTTOM: a band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; and along the bottom edge, partly cut off, the tops of long glossy pale pearl-ivory fibre bundles. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte.

THREE DIFFERENT THINGS ARE HAPPENING AT ONCE, AT THREE DIFFERENT DEPTHS.

AT THE SURFACE, the quilted pads are swollen, round, taut and glassy, fuller than the tissue below them would suggest, and inside each pad several tiny clear water droplets are held, in three clearly different sizes — some large, some medium, some very small. A clean bright band of reflected light runs along the top of the block where the light catches the swollen pads, brilliant but soft, with the shape of every pad still visible modelled through it and never flattening into a plain white stripe.

IN THE AIR ABOVE, floating at slightly different heights, are six translucent spheres of clear pale glass holding three different things, each a different SHAPE rather than a different colour: two hold a chain of exactly THREE small pearl-white beads linked in a neat short row; two hold a single small colourless faceted crystal, clean-edged and glassy; two hold a much longer chain of eight or nine small pearl-white beads. A few looser chains of four beads drift among them.

Also in the air, fine dark grey angular motes are falling toward the skin — and they are BREAKING UP AND FADING, thinning to faint specks and vanishing before they land, so the air close to the surface is clear. Off to one side, one faceted crystal has gone dull and clouded; a three-bead chain floats right beside it, and where the two meet the crystal is visibly clearing back to bright and glassy again, the dullness lifting off it.

DEEP DOWN, slender shafts of warm white light descend from the longer bead chains, through the pads and the cream film, into the granular band below, where a soft bloom spreads and a small star-shaped glint bursts. The pale-pink granules in that band lie settled and evenly spaced, with a scattering of soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules distributed smoothly among them rather than gathered into clusters or blotches.

Nothing is broken, nothing is being scrubbed and no mark is being erased from the skin. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
